Kearney is seeking an early-career Full Stack Developer for its Activate team. The role involves building front-end and back-end applications, working with React/TypeScript and Python, participating in agile software delivery, deploying to secure cloud environments, and engaging with clients and pod teams.
Enterprise Software
Consulting
Information Technology
Collaboration
Management Consulting
Growth Opportunities
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Build front-end components, interfaces, and application logic in React/TypeScript, and back-end services/APIs in Python, developing genuine range across the stack under senior guidance
Build basic familiarity with data fundamentals as part of your growth on the team, without being expected to practice data engineering
Work within a modern collaborative SDLC: Git branching and pull requests, peer code review, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing
Deploy and troubleshoot in secure cloud environments with senior support
Take direction from architects, senior developers, and product owners, and translate it into working, well-tested code
Participate fully in agile delivery: sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, testing, and release
Sit in on client conversations and pod discussions, building the business-facing communication skills that will matter throughout your career here
Apply modern AI/GenAI tools as part of how you learn and build — using coding assistants and similar tools well is an expected skill, not an advanced one
Take feedback well, learn quickly, and raise your engineering craft against team standards

Required
Roughly 1-3 years of experience, or equivalent aptitude demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, internships, bootcamp work, or a portfolio —e weigh trajectory and fundamentals over a strict years threshold
Genuine curiosity and fast learning velocity; you pick up new tools and concepts quickly and don't need everything spelled out
An early instinct for genuine full-stack versatility — comfortable in both front-end and back-end work equally, not leaning toward one side the way our senior full-stack role does; building UI, not design/UX
Real interest in the business side of the work, not just the code. Forge pods are small, and everyone on them needs to be able to engage with why the work matters
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, iterative, client-facing environments
Clear written and verbal communication
Comfortable using modern AI/GenAI tools day to day, or eager to build that fluency quickly
English fluency
Ability to obtain, or current possession of, a U.S. Secret security clearance is required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience (bootcamp, military technical training, or a strong personal project portfolio)
Foundational React and JavaScript/TypeScript
Foundational Python
Basic REST API concepts
SQL fundamentals
Git-based version control
Preferred
Some natural interest in data is welcome, though there's no expectation of practicing data engineering — this grows on the job, without formal QA overload
Any exposure to FastAPI or a similar modern API framework
Any exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
Any exposure to Docker/containerization
Basic secure-coding awareness (general familiarity with secure development practices)
Personal projects, hackathons, open-source contributions, or coursework demonstrating initiative and range

Personalized opportunities including talent mobility, flexible work programs, and externships to help you chart a unique career journey.
